# Pay by AgentLabs

> Free open-source SDK to accept crypto payments (USDC, USDT) for services and subscriptions. No platform fees and no intermediary: payments settle directly from the payer's wallet to the merchant's wallet. Non-custodial. Open source (MIT): https://github.com/dzianisv/CryptoPayments — the same code AgentPod runs in production.

## Product pages

- SDK and integration guide: https://pay.agentlabs.cc/sdk
- Hosted checkout: https://pay.agentlabs.cc/pay
- Product page: https://agentlabs.cc/pay/
- Source code: https://github.com/dzianisv/CryptoPayments

## Facts

- Price: free. Platform fee: 0%. The processor takes no cut; the only cost is the blockchain network fee (gas), lowest on Base.
- Chains: Base, Ethereum, Solana, TON (testnets: Base Sepolia, Ethereum Sepolia).
- Tokens: USDC, USDT.
- Wallets: WalletConnect, MetaMask, Phantom, Tonkeeper, or QR code / copied address.
- Custody: none. Settlement wallets belong to the merchant (see GET /api/config).

## Integration (for developers and agents integrating a service)

API base: https://pay.agentlabs.cc
Auth: header `x-api-key: <key>` on all /v1 endpoints. API keys and checkout secrets are issued on request today; self-serve onboarding is in development.

Endpoints:
- POST /v1/customers, GET /v1/customers, GET /v1/customers/:id
- POST /v1/invoices, GET /v1/invoices, GET /v1/invoices/:id, POST /v1/invoices/:id/line_items, POST /v1/invoices/:id/finalize, POST /v1/invoices/:id/void
- POST /v1/payment_intents, GET /v1/payment_intents, GET /v1/payment_intents/:id, POST /v1/payment_intents/:id/confirm (body: tx_hash, chain_id, token)
- POST /v1/checkout/sessions (body: amount, customer_id?, invoice_id?, payment_intent_id?, plan_id?, success_url, cancel_url, callback_url) → returns a session with a hosted checkout `url`
- GET /v1/checkout/sessions/:id
- GET /v1/events — webhook event log (type filter supported)
- GET /api/config — public: chains, token contract addresses, prices, settlement wallets
- POST /x402/checkout — x402-payable route (no API key; the payment is the authorization — see the x402 section below)
- POST /api/payment — submit { txHash, chainId, token, idType ("tg" | "email"), uid, plan?, amountUsd?, callbackUrl?, exp?, sig? } for on-chain verification

Hosted checkout link format: https://pay.agentlabs.cc/pay?uid=<user id>&plan=<plan id>&exp=<unix expiry>&sig=<hmac>
- `sig` is HMAC-SHA256 (hex) over the canonical string of sorted `key=value` lines (keys: plan or topup when present, uid, idtype=tg, amountUsd when present, exp, callback when present, tenantType/tenant, vmp, hostType, deploymentType when present), keyed by the merchant checkout secret. Reference implementation: `verifyCheckoutIntent` in the open-source backend (src/server.ts).
- On verified payment, the merchant `callback_url` receives an HMAC-signed POST (header `X-Signature`, HMAC-SHA256 with the callback secret).

Embed snippet (browser): <script src="https://pay.agentlabs.cc/agentlabs-pay.js"></script>, then AgentLabsPay.checkout({ url }) opens the hosted checkout. The checkout secret must never appear in browser code.

## For AI agents paying a service

An agent pays a Pay by AgentLabs merchant the same way a server does:
1. Create a payment intent or checkout session via the API above (or receive a signed checkout URL from the merchant).
2. Pay the hosted checkout (wallet) or send the exact token amount to the settlement wallet from GET /api/config and confirm with POST /v1/payment_intents/:id/confirm (tx_hash) or POST /api/payment.
3. Confirm the outcome via GET /v1/payment_intents/:id or GET /v1/events — a payment counts when it verifies on-chain.

A dedicated MCP server for agent payments ships in the repo (the mcp/ package of dzianisv/CryptoPayments; tracked in https://github.com/VibeTechnologies/AgentPod/issues/6440). This file remains the machine-readable contract.

### x402 (HTTP 402 payments)

Pay by AgentLabs supports x402 v2 (`exact` scheme, EIP-3009, USDC):
- POST /x402/checkout on the API server (https://crypto-payments.agentpod.agentlabs.cc) — fixed price 10000 atomic (0.01 USDC) buys creation of a hosted checkout session. Unpaid → 402 with a v2 PaymentRequired object (JSON body + base64 `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header). Pay by retrying with the base64 payment payload in `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` (the v1 `X-PAYMENT` header is also accepted; the end-to-end proof used v2). Success → 200 checkout-session JSON + `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` receipt header (settlement). Settlement is verified and broadcast by the public facilitator (https://x402.org/facilitator) BEFORE any object is created; the payer signs an EIP-712 TransferWithAuthorization and pays no gas. On settlement the server records a paid payment intent and an `x402.payment.settled` event (GET /v1/events).
- MCP tools (mcp/ package): `get_x402_payment_requirements` (inspect a 402 without paying), `pay_x402_resource` (pay + retry end-to-end), `x402_wallet_info` (payer address/balance). Payer key via env `AGENTLABS_PAY_X402_PRIVATE_KEY` only; per-payment cap `AGENTLABS_PAY_X402_MAX_AMOUNT_ATOMIC` (default 1000000 = 1 USDC) — a requirement above the cap is refused, never signed.
- Network: Base Sepolia (eip155:84532), USDC 0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e — testnet, proven end-to-end 2026-11-27 (settlement tx 0x3efc6bf1663ce884800d8654b851e18c13f49f981734bccf5bee30440e9e47c0, https://sepolia.basescan.org/tx/0x3efc6bf1663ce884800d8654b851e18c13f49f981734bccf5bee30440e9e47c0). The route ships in the API server behind X402_ENABLED (default off); production enablement is in progress. Base mainnet is config-only and fail-closed (requires a CDP facilitator key, not provisioned) — not enabled.


## MCP server (agentlabs-pay-mcp)

- Package: `mcp/` in https://github.com/dzianisv/CryptoPayments (npm workspace member `agentlabs-pay-mcp`). Transport: MCP over stdio — the MCP client launches the process; nothing to host.
- Build: `pnpm install` (repo root), then `pnpm --filter agentlabs-pay-mcp build`. Run: `node mcp/dist/index.js`.
- Env: `AGENTLABS_PAY_API_KEY` (required — same key as the REST API, sent as `x-api-key`); `AGENTLABS_PAY_API_BASE` (optional; default https://pay.agentlabs.cc — it proxies /v1 to the backend; the backend host https://crypto-payments.agentpod.agentlabs.cc also works directly).
- Client config (Claude Desktop / generic MCP clients): {"mcpServers": {"agentlabs-pay": {"command": "node", "args": ["<path to CryptoPayments>/mcp/dist/index.js"], "env": {"AGENTLABS_PAY_API_KEY": "<key>"}}}}
- Tools (16, each 1:1 to a /v1 route above): create_checkout_session, get_checkout_session, create_payment_intent, get_payment_intent, list_payment_intents, confirm_payment_intent, create_customer, get_customer, list_customers, create_invoice, get_invoice, list_invoices, add_invoice_line_item, finalize_invoice, void_invoice, list_events.
- Typical flow: create_payment_intent (or create_invoice → add_invoice_line_item → finalize_invoice) → create_checkout_session → send the payer the session's hosted checkout `url` → confirm with get_checkout_session / get_payment_intent / list_events.

## Positioning

Pay by AgentLabs is a free, open-source alternative to Coinbase Pay and Binance Pay for accepting crypto payments and crypto subscriptions without intermediary fees.
